description: Trigger accuracy evals for the monte-carlo-onboarding skill. Each case tests whether a single prompt should activate the skill.

cases.prompt: Connect our Snowflake account to Monte Carlo.
Add a BigQuery connection to Monte Carlo for the analytics project.
Our Redshift cluster is only reachable inside the VPC. How do we get Monte Carlo monitoring it?
cases.rationale: Private connectivity needs discovery; it does not by itself require an agent

cases.prompt: We need a Monte Carlo collection agent in our AWS account.
cases.rationale: Agent deployment is step 1 of onboarding

cases.prompt: Set up a data store so Monte Carlo never keeps sampled rows on its side, then connect Databricks.
Generate the Terraform to onboard our Snowflake warehouse to Monte Carlo through an agent.
cases.rationale: Terraform output mode of the onboarding flow

cases.prompt: Write a Python script that creates the Monte Carlo warehouse and connection for our Oracle database.
Which Monte Carlo deployment should the new Starburst connection run through?
cases.rationale: Deployment choice question the skill answers

cases.prompt: How should we give Monte Carlo the credentials for Snowflake? We keep secrets in AWS Secrets Manager.
Onboard our warehouse to Monte Carlo.
Connect Snowflake to Monte Carlo through an AWS agent.
cases.rationale: The M3 demo scenario: warehouse plus agent deployment

cases.prompt: Onboard BigQuery to Monte Carlo.
cases.rationale: Onboarding phrasing with a named platform

cases.prompt: Set up an agent for Monte Carlo in our AWS account so it can reach our warehouse.
cases.rationale: Collection agent setup, phrased without the word 'collection'

cases.prompt: We just signed up for Monte Carlo. How do we get our Databricks workspace connected?
Push metadata and lineage from our homegrown catalog into Monte Carlo.
cases.rationale: Push ingestion, no connector: push-ingestion skill

cases.prompt: Build the Connection Auth Rules JSON for our Postgres connector.
Instrument our LangChain agent for Monte Carlo Agent Observability.
What should I monitor in our Snowflake warehouse? Where are the coverage gaps?
Why is orders_daily stale since this morning?
Connect to the Snowflake database with SQLAlchemy in this Python service.
cases.rationale: Application database connection, nothing to do with Monte Carlo

cases.prompt: Create a freshness monitor on analytics.orders in Monte Carlo.
cases.rationale: Monitor creation on a connected table

cases.prompt: Triage last night's Monte Carlo alerts and tell me which ones are real incidents.
What is the root cause of the volume drop on fct_orders?
Set up monitoring for the new tables in our analytics schema.
Our Snowflake metadata in Monte Carlo stopped updating this morning. What broke?
cases.rationale: Incident on an existing connection, not onboarding
